content.short: Magic Eden is the best place to trade assets onchain.
content.description: Since its launch in September 2021, Magic Eden has operated as an NFT marketplace built on the Solana blockchain. The platform enables users to buy, mint, and sell NFTs, providing a streamlined experience for creators and collectors alike. Developers can access a range of endpoints through Magic Eden's API to retrieve data and integrate it into their own applications or tools. With low transaction costs and no fees charged to creators for listing, Magic Eden supports accessible NFT activity on Solana.
